verdict.rationale: Unleash is a SaaS and self-hostable feature-flag platform, so a policy or control preventing customer data from being used for AI training is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack has no AI-training opt-out, policy, or commitment. The nearest items are adjacent data-locality features: Edge keeps targeting PII local, external metrics stay in the customer's system, and self-hosting is available. These do not address AI model training, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
